Name: Luny's Rabbit Ears for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿
[center]This is a simple mod that adds three types of colorable rabbit ears to Fashion Sense.
I was feeling kinda stressed lately, so I decided to make a simple little mod to relax.

These ears were inspired by Viera in FFXIV, but not meant to be an exact match. Just inspired. ♡




[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]

Extract the zip file and copy [FS] Luny's Rabbit Ears into your StardewValley/Mods folder.
The ears will then be available in FS as headwear.
[b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sii0Iov.gif[/img]﻿[/b][/center]
